target_customer: Consumers ordering fast food in Mumbai, via dine in QSR outlets and cloud kitchens
problem: Building multi-brand fast food chains in India with short payback per store.
business_model: Owned restaurant brands, QSR and cloud kitchen formats with delivery apps

founders.name: Nishant Jhaveri
prior_employers: India's largest auto dealership group (CEO's Office growth role)

founders.name: Pranav Mehra
education: Indiana University, BA Telecommunications and Psychology
previous_startups: Talent placement platform for the film and entertainment industry
founders.background_notes: Per YC page: leads marketing, branding and business development; the page labels the school as Indiana alumni.

competitors.name: Rebel Foods (Faasos)
competitors.what: Largest Indian cloud kitchen operator with many owned brands
competitors.funding_then: $15.8M round from Sequoia and others reported 2019-03

technical_complexity.rationale: Restaurant operations and delivery logistics rather than novel technology.

defensibility.rationale: Owned brands and operations know how, but cloud kitchens were easy to replicate and capital funded rivals were far larger.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Not established by the sources found.

market_need_then: Cloud kitchen investment boom in India in 2019 to 2021 and growing delivery demand; the founders claimed profitability and sub one year store payback (YC description, self reported).

branding.brand_signature: House of brands approach: Nino Burgers, Francesco's Pizzeria (acquired eight year old Mumbai brand converted to delivery only) and KHA Fried Chicken.

brand_strength.rationale: Small regional brands, only founder interviews and a few outlet pieces; co-founder leads branding per YC page.

outcome_analysis: Nino Foods was a Mumbai multi brand fast food operator that grew to about 20 locations and reported profitability in its YC profile, then raised a seed of about 1.6 million dollars in December 2021. The YC directory lists it as inactive, while CB Insights lists it as alive and no closure report was found, so the status and any cause are not public.
notes: Status conflict: YC says inactive, CB Insights says alive; site returned HTTP 402 on fetch. The seed amount and investors come from YourStory and The Startup Lab via search summaries (YourStory page returned 403); another database said no funding, which conflicts and is weighted low. Competitors beyond Rebel Foods (Box8, FreshMenu) had only undated sources and are not listed. Brand name origin not found.
